tools.name: cheapest_routes
tools.description: Use this when someone asks where they can fly cheaply from a city, or for flight deals under a budget or in a month. Returns the cheapest fare on each route with fares from an origin (or into a destination), cheapest one-way first, each with its cheapest round trip of a 3 to 21 day stay in `return`

tools.name: find_airports
tools.description: Look up airports and city codes by name, or list the airports near an airport code. Use it to turn a city name into the IATA code a flight search with the other tools takes.

tools.name: meet_link
tools.description: A link to a2bflight.com's group page for people flying from different homes to meet in one place. Use it when the user already knows where; where_to_meet when they ask where. Without dates it picks the weekend, of the next eight, whose round trips cover everyone for the lowest total, and returns eac

tools.name: route_fares
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about flights, flight prices, airfare or cheap plane tickets between two airports or cities (for example Seoul to Tokyo; find_airports turns a city into its airports). Returns the fares for one airport pair: the cheapest one-way, the cheapest round trip of a 3 to 21 day st

tools.name: where_to_meet
tools.description: Where 2 to 8 people flying from different homes can meet cheapest: the places every home has a route into, each with a weekend that has a round trip for everyone, each person's fare, the total, and meet_url — the group's page with all of it filled in. A place with a warning is a poor option: say why
